The structure of La2Cu2Hg2Se8 (LaCuHgSe4) is cubic with space group F-43m (No. 216) and 16 atoms per unit cell across four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cu and Hg each adopt tetrahedral environments with four Se neighbors, while La exhibits an octahedral environment with six Se neighbors. The same analysis identifies corner-sharing between Cu and Hg tetrahedra and La octahedra, plus edge-sharing between La octahedra. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites.
